title: Skill-gap report, schema version 1
description: The latest analysis of one student, as the AI service writes it to skill_gap_reports.report (Flyway V7) and the backend reads it back for display. Written by skillbridge-ai-service/report_store.py::report_document; read by com.skillbridge.skillgap.SkillGapReportDocument. Strict, like the AI events: adding a field is a reviewed change to this file, and both sides test against it.

status.description: SUCCESS: jobs were searched. SKIPPED: the student has no skills, so there was nothing to search with. A failed analysis is not written; it is retried, then dead-lettered.

studentSkills.description: The skills the analysis used, normalised (lower case, trimmed).

matchedJobs.description: Most similar first. Empty when SKIPPED, or when no job cleared the similarity threshold.

missingSkills.description: The union of every matched job's missing skills.

analyzedAt.description: When the analysis ran, UTC, ISO-8601 with a Z.
